# DigiSpher Products

> DigiSpher engineers offline-first desktop privacy tools, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) implementation toolkits, and software monetization systems for complete digital ownership.

DigiSpher provides battle-tested toolkits, playbooks, and desktop software designed for founders, marketers, and developers who refuse to rent their core digital capabilities. Our systems prioritize local execution, verified documentation, and machine-readable transparency.

## Core Products & Toolkits

- [Get Quoted: The GEO Playbook for Winning AI Search](https://digispher-products.digispher.online/geo-playbook.html): A 41-page implementation guide and SOP toolkit for optimizing brands to be cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews. Includes 5 operational checklists, prompt tracker spreadsheet, and copy-paste bot/schema configurations.
- [The 10-Minute AI Visibility Check](https://digispher-products.digispher.online/ai-visibility-check.html): Free 9-page guide with 5 starter prompts, a 0-40 scoring tracker, and 5 foundational fixes for AI search. Helps businesses audit whether AI engines cite their brand or competitors.
- [The Software Pricing Playbook](https://digispher-products.digispher.online/software-pricing.html): Strategic pricing frameworks, lifetime-deal monetization models, and margin optimization for software founders and indie hackers.
- [DropSpher Desktop App](https://digispher-products.digispher.online/dropspher.html): 100% offline desktop file powerhouse. Converts PDF to Word locally with formatting retention, batch processes images and videos, and scrubs EXIF metadata with zero cloud uploads. Live app portal: https://dropspher.digispher.online
- [DigiSpherEMR V2](https://digispher-products.digispher.online/ds-emr.html): Offline-first medical practice management system with encrypted local SQLite storage, appointment scheduling, and prescription generation for independent healthcare providers. Live app portal: https://ds-emr.digispher.online
- [DigiSpher Agency & Web Services](https://digispher-products.digispher.online/agency-services.html): Bespoke web architecture, full-stack application engineering, and technical GEO implementation. Main agency site: https://digispher.online
